metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM unifying parser for AWS CloudTrail activity
properties.query:
let DisabledParsers=materialize(_GetWatchlist('ASimDisabledParsers') | where SearchKey in ('Any', 'ExcludeASimAuditEvent') | extend SourceSpecificParser=column_ifexists('SourceSpecificParser','') | distinct SourceSpecificParser);
let BuiltInDisabled=disabled or toscalar('ExcludeASimAuditEventBuiltIn' in (DisabledParsers) or 'ExcludeASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrail' in (DisabledParsers) or 'Any' in (DisabledParsers));
union isfuzzy=true
  ASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2Instances(disabled=(BuiltInDisabled or ('ExcludeASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2Instances' in (DisabledParsers))), pack=pack),
  ASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2LaunchAndAccess(disabled=(BuiltInDisabled or ('ExcludeASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2LaunchAndAccess' in (DisabledParsers))), pack=pack),
  ASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2CapacityAndReservations(disabled=(BuiltInDisabled or ('ExcludeASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2CapacityAndReservations' in (DisabledParsers))), pack=pack),
  ASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2FleetAndSpot(disabled=(BuiltInDisabled or ('ExcludeASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2FleetAndSpot' in (DisabledParsers))), pack=pack),
  ASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2ImagesAndImportExport(disabled=(BuiltInDisabled or ('ExcludeASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2ImagesAndImportExport' in (DisabledParsers))), pack=pack),
  ASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2EBS(disabled=(BuiltInDisabled or ('ExcludeASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2EBS' in (DisabledParsers))), pack=pack),
  ASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2VPCCoreAndRouting(disabled=(BuiltInDisabled or ('ExcludeASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2VPCCoreAndRouting' in (DisabledParsers))), pack=pack),
  ASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2InterfacesAndAddresses(disabled=(BuiltInDisabled or ('ExcludeASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2InterfacesAndAddresses' in (DisabledParsers))), pack=pack),
  ASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2SecurityAndObservability(disabled=(BuiltInDisabled or ('ExcludeASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2SecurityAndObservability' in (DisabledParsers))), pack=pack),
  ASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2IPAM(disabled=(BuiltInDisabled or ('ExcludeASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2IPAM' in (DisabledParsers))), pack=pack),
  ASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2IPAMRouting(disabled=(BuiltInDisabled or ('ExcludeASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2IPAMRouting' in (DisabledParsers))), pack=pack),
  ASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2TransitGateway(disabled=(BuiltInDisabled or ('ExcludeASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2TransitGateway' in (DisabledParsers))), pack=pack),
  ASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2TransitGatewayRouting(disabled=(BuiltInDisabled or ('ExcludeASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2TransitGatewayRouting' in (DisabledParsers))), pack=pack),
  ASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2PrivateConnectivity(disabled=(BuiltInDisabled or ('ExcludeASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2PrivateConnectivity' in (DisabledParsers))), pack=pack),
  ASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2VerifiedAccess(disabled=(BuiltInDisabled or ('ExcludeASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2VerifiedAccess' in (DisabledParsers))), pack=pack),
  ASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2AccountAndInfrastructure(disabled=(BuiltInDisabled or ('ExcludeASimAuditEventAWSCloudTrailEC2AccountAndInfrastructure' in (DisabledParsers))), pack=pack)
| extend 
  EventVendor = "AWS",
  EventProduct = "CloudTrail"
